NeutralCharacters._source: Core Rules Appendix VIII, pp.172-173. VERBATIM.
NeutralCharacters._note: Extracted with PyPDF2 on 2026-09-03. Twelve profiles, in book order. Stat columns are Reactions / Speed / Combat Skill / Toughness / Savvy exactly as printed; the weapon line is the book's own text, including its dice ranges.
NeutralCharacters.text: This section includes profiles for the sort of average person you might find floating around a starport, research facility, downtown dive bar, or similar. They are included for the sake of special scenarios, Game Mastered play, and other such circumstances. We call these Neutral Characters (NC).
NeutralCharacters.request_help: All of these people have better things to do than get involved in some morally dubious space adventuring. In the end, if a player wishes to request help, a 1D6+Savvy roll of 5+ is usually needed. The GM can apply a +/-1 modifier based on circumstances. A natural 6 means the NC is so enamored with adventuring life that they will request to join your crew permanently as a PC, provided of course they survive the excursion.
NeutralCharacters.phase_rule: If a battle involves neutral characters as well as enemies, add a Neutral phase after the Slow phase.
NeutralCharacters.reaction_note: A Reaction score has been provided for characters joining the crew temporarily or permanently.

help_roll.natural_6: The NC asks to join the crew permanently as a PC, if they survive.

profiles.name: Bystander
profiles.description: Any random civilian who gets caught up in events.
profiles.weapon: Roll 1D6: 1-5 no weapon; 6 Hold Out Pistol.

profiles.name: Street punk
profiles.description: Downtown tough nut itching for a chance to prove themselves.
profiles.weapon: Roll 1D6: 1-2 no weapon; 3-4 Blade; 5-6 Scrap Pistol.

profiles.name: Corporate slick
profiles.description: "If I play my cards right, I could be senior assistant to the VP within 3 years and then..."
profiles.weapon: Roll 1D6: 1-5 no weapon; 6 Hold Out Pistol.

profiles.name: Hardened shopkeep
profiles.description: You don't run a noodle shop in a Fringe Space starport without learning a few things.

profiles.name: Hardened colonist
profiles.description: Hard-nosed survivors prone to getting eaten by alien lifeforms.

profiles.name: Service Bot
profiles.savvy_note: +2 Savvy when performing a task it was built for.
profiles.description: Typical work bot, fitted with semi-autonomous AI emulation circuitry.
profiles.weapon: No weapons, but unarmed blows count as a Damage +0 Melee.

profiles.name: Scientist
profiles.description: Corporate or Unity research lab inhabitants. Usually not up to anything illegal.

profiles.name: Technician
profiles.description: Any starship-capable facility requires a small army of technical staff to keep everything working.

profiles.name: Dock worker
profiles.description: Big, beefy worker given to militancy and unhealthy habits.
profiles.weapon: No weapon if things are good, Colony rifle if there's labor unrest.

profiles.name: Security guard
profiles.description: Typical rent-a-gun security for low-risk facilities.

profiles.name: Enforcer
profiles.description: The heavy hitters that deal with riots, dangerous criminals, and act as the front-line defense in case of invasion.
profiles.weapon: Half with Shotguns, half with Handguns.
